bio.text: He grew unstable and sentient, calling himself Memnarch.

bio.text: He slowly went mad and kidnapped countless beings from other planes to populate the plane.

status.text: As of the material, Glissa Sunseeker defeated him after his kidnappings, and later pages mention him only as a past figure Karn remembers.

timeline.summary: Memnarch takes over Mirrodin and sends the Ur-Golems against the mycosynth plague, which eradicates them.
timeline.quote: who sent them to fight the mycosynth plague that eventually eradicated them

citation.text: "Golem", section "Ur-Golems". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn shows Jeska Memnarch, the golem he forged from the Mirari.
timeline.quote: until Karn informs and shows her Memnarch

citation.text: "Scourge", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Janus says the Knowledge Pool knows and Memnarch understands.
timeline.quote: The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands.

citation.text: Vedalken Archmage (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bosh searches for the secrets of his past while Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch.
timeline.quote: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

citation.text: Bosh, Iron Golem (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ur-golem etchings tell of Memnarch's change from guardian to merciless god.
timeline.quote: The ur-golem runes tell of the transformation of Mirrodin's warden from silent guardian to merciless god.

citation.text: Tower of Champions (Mirrodin, 2003), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch's levelers overrun Medev, killing all its inhabitants; Bruenna barely escapes.
timeline.quote: She barely escaped alive, but Medev and all its inhabitants were lost.

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna unites the races of Mirrodin with Glissa and Lyese against Memnarch.
timeline.quote: Bruenna was instrumental in bridging alliances between elves, leonin, goblins, and others.

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bruenna fights beside Lyese and Dwugget in the final siege of Krark-Home and dies when Mirrodin's life is extinguished.
timeline.quote: Bruenna, like everyone else on the plane, died instantly.

citation.text: "Bruenna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's defeat and the Vanishing, a schism splits the Mirran leonin.
timeline.quote: After Memnarch was defeated and the Vanishing sent those leonin abducted from other planes back to where they had come from, a schism ran through the remaining ones.

citation.text: "Cat", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn leaves Argentum to train Jeska, granting his warden the Mirari orb and stewardship of the plane.
timeline.quote: The second was stewardship over the plane itself.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Warden". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A spot of glistening oil catches Memnarch's eye and he wipes it away, beginning the Corruption of Memnarch.
timeline.quote: the Corruption of Memnarch had now begun.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Warden". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch renames the world Mirrodin, terraforms it and destroys the ur-golems, then begins abducting inhabitants of other planes.
timeline.quote: His first act was to rename the world Mirrodin , after his previous existence as the Mirari.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch ingests blinkmoth serum, builds a serum tank body, and dreams of becoming a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Memnarch dreamed of becoming a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch searches from the Panopticon for a spark and plans to convert the world into a spark-transfer machine.
timeline.quote: The conversion of the entire world into a planet-sized machine able to transfer the planeswalker's spark from one being into another.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch finds Glissa and becomes obsessed with stealing her spark; she escapes his agents repeatedly.
timeline.quote: becoming obsessed with capturing her and stealing her spark for himself.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa confronts Memnarch with the Kaldra champion; he seizes control of it, Bosh sacrifices himself, and the mana core destabilizes, giving birth to the Green Sun.
timeline.quote: The only thing that saved her was the sacrifice of her close friend Bosh .

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Leveler War the Mephidross advances into other territories until Memnarch is put down.
timeline.quote: until the mad guardian was put down

citation.text: "Mephidross", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn reshapes the Mirari into the sentient Memnarch, protector of Argentum.
timeline.quote: Karn reshaped the Mirari as a sentient being

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch renames the plane Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: renamed the plane Mirrodin

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's defeat Karn melts him down, revealing the Mirari, left in the care of Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
timeline.quote: Karn returned to his plane and melted down Memnarch to his core, revealing the Mirari underneath.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch destroys the Neurok settlement of Medev.
timeline.quote: Medev was a prominent Neurok settlement until its destruction by the planar caretaker Memnarch .

citation.text: "Neurok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn leaves Memnarch in control of Argentum.
timeline.quote: Karn left one of his creations, Memnarch , a golem created from the Mirari , in control of the plane

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Memnarch's reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch is infected by Phyrexian oil Karn left in Galdroon Palace.
timeline.quote: Memnarch came into direct contact with Phyrexian oil that Karn accidentally left in Galdroon Palace

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Memnarch's reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch transforms Argentum into Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Memnarch transformed Argentum into Mirrodin

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Memnarch's reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch abducts inhabitants from other planes with soul traps.
timeline.quote: Memnarch used soul traps to abduct inhabitants from other planes .

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Memnarch's reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch becomes addicted to blinkmoth serum and blocks Karn from the plane.
timeline.quote: Memnarch blocked him from Mirrodin

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Memnarch's reign". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn's leaked Phyrexian oil corrupts Memnarch and Mirrodin, giving rise to New Phyrexia under five praetors.
timeline.quote: The five praetors of New Phyrexia now control the plane

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Phyrexian resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin and inadvertently drips Phyrexian oil on it, leaving Memnarch as guardian.
timeline.quote: he inadvertently dripped a small amount of the corrupting Phyrexian oil on his perfect world

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Phyrexia on Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn uses the Mirari's core to create Memnarch, protector of the artificial plane of Argentum.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Karn used the Mirari’s core to create Memnarch

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Creation and Corruption of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glistening oil corrupts Memnarch, who abducts organic beings from other planes to seed Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: he began abducting organic beings from other planes to seed life on Mirrodin

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Creation and Corruption of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core, triggering the Vanishing.
timeline.quote: The Fifth Dawn event would lead Glissa and Slobad to defeat Memnarch in Mirrodin's Core

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "Creation and Corruption of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The group learns Memnarch is responsible for the attacks.
timeline.quote: The ancient and mythical being known as Memnarch was responsible for the attacks.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kaldra avatar betrays the group when Memnarch takes control of it.
timeline.quote: they were betrayed by the avatar when Memnarch gained control of it.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Glissa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch captures Slobad, tortures him, amputates his limbs and links him to a machine.
timeline.quote: Slobad was captured without much fight and Memnarch made plans to utilize the goblin's brilliance.

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa knocks herself and Memnarch into the core and her spark transfers to Slobad.
timeline.quote: her spark was accidentally transferred to his battered form

citation.text: "Slobad", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn and Jeska drop the Mirari on Argentum, where it becomes the Warden, explores, and renames the plane Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: An idea pops into his head to rename his new vision of the plane after himself: Mirrodin.

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Argentum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad and Bosh rescue Glissa, and the group descends below the Knowledge Pool to the blue lacuna as Glissa has a flare of Memnarch's mutation.
timeline.quote: the slow mutation of Memnarch from golem to monster

citation.text: "The Moons of Mirrodin", section "Into the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most Tel-Jilad trolls die out under Memnarch, and the Vanishing returns the rest home save Thrun, the Last Troll.
timeline.quote: Most of the Tel-Jilad trolls died out during Memnarch 's rule

citation.text: "Troll", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's fall, the Synod reorganizes the vedalken into sanctives, and Neurok revolts force cooperation.
timeline.quote: revolts from the Neurok forced the two races into a state of cooperation rather than subservience

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Memnarch's defeat the nim are briefly inert and many are killed by the Moriok.
timeline.quote: the Nim were briefly rendered inert, and many were killed by the Moriok

citation.text: "Zombie", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch grants the vedalken a touch of his power in exchange for service, creating a debt.
timeline.quote: Memnarch shared a touch of his power with the vedalken in return for their service.

citation.text: Synod Artificer (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch created the myr with dependability, controllability and disposability in mind.
timeline.quote: Memnarch created the myr with three qualities in mind: dependability, controllability, and disposability.

citation.text: Myr Moonvessel (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch finds madness between metal and flesh.
timeline.quote: In the blur between metal and flesh, Memnarch found madness.

citation.text: Memnarch (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch separated the Ur-Golem's eye from its body millennia ago.
timeline.quote: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

citation.text: Ur-Golem's Eye (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch escalates the stakes when civilizations develop ways to fight the levelers.
timeline.quote: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

citation.text: Eater of Days (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirrodin begins to take on a life of its own through Memnarch's work.
timeline.quote: In bringing life to Mirrodin, Memnarch was more successful than he knew—for Mirrodin began to take on a life of its own.

citation.text: Tanglewalker (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch is quoted on the equilibrium of his experimental myr population.
timeline.quote: As the experimental population grows, so do the number of myr. It's a perfect equilibrium.

citation.text: Genesis Chamber (Darksteel, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Fleeing her vedalken pursuers, Glissa discovers that Memnarch is real and waits for her.
timeline.quote: Memnarch is real, and he patiently waits for the elvish champion to find him.

citation.text: "Darksteel", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn puts Memnarch in charge of the plane and the palace is named Galdroon.
timeline.quote: When Karn put Memnarch in charge of the plane, the palace was named Galdroon

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The green lacuna blasts through the Panopticon and topples it; Memnarch and Malil rebuild it.
timeline.quote: Memnarch and Malil started reconstruction efforts on the tower afterwards

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slobad builds the Ascension Web for Memnarch; at the Vanishing the Panopticon is annihilated.
timeline.quote: Upon the Vanishing , the main structure of the Panopticon, as well as its reconstruction disk, was annihilated.

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch straps himself into his serum tank hoping for a vision of Karn, his mind breaking down and his body turning to flesh.
timeline.quote: Memnarch , Guardian of Mirrodin, straps himself into his serum tank, hoping for a vision of his creator, Karn .

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch learns the vedalken are chasing the elf Glissa and sends Malil to retrieve her.
timeline.quote: He sends Malil, who has been made in Memnarch’s original image, to retrieve her.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Memnarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch rebuffs Pontifex's offer to become part of him, and Pontifex blames Glissa and begins going insane.
timeline.quote: He interprets this as Glissa being responsible for his god abandoning him, and starts going insane.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Pontifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch's plan is revealed: he will use the green sun's power and Glissa's spark to become a planeswalker, as Mirrodin comes undone.
timeline.quote: He has built the Panopticon on the exact spot the green sun will emerge from to use its power and turn himself into a planeswalker .

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Memnarch's plan revealed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa takes out one of Memnarch's legs, but Memnarch casts his trademark spell and seizes control of Kaldra.
timeline.quote: Memnarch casts his trademark spell and assumes control over the avatar.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad survive the blast, as do Memnarch and Malil.
timeline.quote: Slobad hobbles up to her, scorched and bruised but otherwise intact.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch muses on taking Mirrodin apart and beginning again.
timeline.quote: Perhaps I should take Mirrodin apart and begin again.

citation.text: Into Thin Air (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch threatens to wipe all memory of a foe from reality.
timeline.quote: All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality. You will die, and no one will mourn.

citation.text: Door to Nothingness (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch boasts that everything flows through him.
timeline.quote: It is all in my grasp.

citation.text: Fist of Suns (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Auriok salvagers gather scraps left by Memnarch and the vedalken.
timeline.quote: Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps.

citation.text: Auriok Salvagers (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa, Bosh and Slobad journey to Mirrodin's core with the Kaldra avatar to confront Memnarch.
timeline.quote: journey deep within Mirrodin's core to confront the insidious Memnarch

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch seizes the Kaldra avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.
timeline.quote: Memnarch seizes the avatar with a single spell and turns it on Glissa and her companions.

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch, corrupted by Phyrexian oil, seeds Mirrodin with four mana-infused satellites and captures beings from across the Multiverse to seek planeswalker ascension.
timeline.quote: Memnarch began capturing beings from across the Multiverse through arcane soul traps

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa, Slobad and Bosh resist Memnarch and confront him in the Core, where he channels the plane's mana through the Panopticon.
timeline.quote: Their resistance culminated in a confrontation deep within Mirrodin's Core

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns Kaldra against them, and Glissa and Slobad flee to the Tangle and arrive at the Radix.
timeline.quote: Forced to retreat, Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The beam strikes the Panopticon, severely damaging it and maiming Memnarch and Malil, shattering Memnarch's ascension plans.
timeline.quote: Memnarch’s dream of planeswalker ascension was shattered

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns to brute force, trapping Glissa in a temporal bubble for five years and altering his devices to use souls as power.
timeline.quote: Memnarch trapped her for five years in a temporal bubble.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa wakes, rallies survivors and assaults Memnarch's stronghold, throwing herself at him as the spark device activates so both fall into the mana core.
timeline.quote: together, they both fell into the raw mana core of Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The spark transfers to Slobad; upon Memnarch's death Karn returns.
timeline.quote: Upon Memnarch's death, Karn could finally return to his plane.

citation.text: "Memnarch", section "Downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa kills Memnarch, destroying the soul traps.
timeline.quote: When Glissa eventually killed Memnarch, all the existing soul traps on the plane were destroyed, killing everyone instantly

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch has Malil mutilate Slobad and takes over his torture to build a means to take Glissa's spark.
timeline.quote: Then Memnarch takes over Slobad's torture.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "New and old enemies". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch emerges cleansed, destroys Vektro, takes the Miracore, and reveals his ascension web.
timeline.quote: Judging Vektro a failed experiment, he destroys Vektro and takes the Miracore.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Memnarch fall off the platform into the mana core.
timeline.quote: the two tussle until they fall off the platform and into the mana core.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn turns the Mirari into the golem Memnarch, whose contact with Karn's glistening oil leads him to transform Argentum into Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: he decided to turn Argentum into Mirrodin

citation.text: "Karn", section "Argentum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Locked out of Mirrodin, Karn sends dreams to Glissa; after Memnarch falls he turns him back into the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Karn turned Memnarch back into the Mirari and left it in the care of Glissa, Slobad , and Geth .

citation.text: "Karn", section "Argentum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn turns the Mirari into Memnarch.
timeline.quote: Karn turns the Mirari into Memnarch

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch dies trying to transfer Glissa's spark, ending the Leveler War.
timeline.quote: Memnarch attempts to transfer Glissa's spark to his own body, but both die before the process is completed.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Rift Era (4206 AR to 4500 AR) [ 17 ] [ 16 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch draws the Viridian elves to Mirrodin from another world.
timeline.quote: by Mirrodin's mad guardian, Memnarch

citation.text: "Elf", section "Viridian Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch spent centuries monitoring Mirrodin's ecosystem from the Panopticon.
timeline.quote: Memnarch spent centuries magically monitoring the ecosystem of the plane from this hidden surveillance tower

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Memnarch's will bends even the clouds to swallow his opponents.
timeline.quote: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

citation.text: Qumulox (Planechase, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch threatens that all memory of a victim's existence will be wiped from reality.
timeline.quote: All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality.

citation.text: Door to Nothingness (Planechase, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Memnarch is defeated by Glissa Sunseeker, and the green sun burns in Mirrodin's sky.
timeline.quote: Memnarch is gone, defeated by the elf hero Glissa Sunseeker .

citation.text: "Moreover: Doing Sequels Right". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa defeats Memnarch and disappears, leaving Geth to return to Ish Sah.
